official.deadline_note: 31 October 2026 is the closing date for submitting documents to the applicant's own national Ministry of (Higher) Education; ministries then evaluate and endorse candidates 1-30 November 2026, and only shortlisted applicants upload the same documents through the SEARCA iSCHO portal 1-31 December 2026.
official.status_note: SEARCA publishes a full AY 2027-2028 timeline: submission to the Ministry of (Higher) Education 1 September-31 October 2026, then documentary evaluation, interviews (15 January-15 April 2027) and release of results from 31 May 2027.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Tuition and other school fees are listed among the scholarship entitlements.
benefits: Travel allowance (roundtrip air ticket from home country to study post and local transportation)
Stipend for food, lodging, and incidental expenses
eligibility: Open to nationals of SEAMEO member countries who are regular employees of academic or research institutions or government agencies
Must not be more than 40 (Master's Degree) or 45 (PhD) years of age at the time of application
Areas of specialization that scholarship applicants must pursue should be relevant to the promotion of agricultural and rural development

Proposed thesis research should strategically contribute to any of the following outcomes: increased farmers' income; improved food security and nutrition; greater climate resilience of agricultural systems; empowered farmers, farmer groups, and agricultural stakeholders and their institutions
requirements: The required documents to be submitted should be in English
Areas of specialization must be in agriculture or related sciences, relevant to agricultural and rural development
Preferred to have IELTS results of 6.0 or TOEFL iBT result of 75, taken within two years before application as proof of English proficiency
documents: Original/certified true copy of transcript of academic records bearing the seal of the University and original signature of the Registrar or Head of the University (BS transcript for MS applicants; BS and MS transcripts for PhD applicants)
Original or certified true copies of certificates of completion/diploma for every degree completed
Accomplished SEARCA scholarship recommendation form from the academic adviser and employer
Brief description of the research the applicant plans to conduct for thesis/dissertation, in line with sustainable transformation of agricultural systems through innovation in Southeast Asia
Certification from a medical doctor that the applicant is in good physical and mental health condition and is fit to undertake graduate studies
selection_criteria: Academic and Professional Background (verified through application documents)
Relevance of Proposed Study Program (verified through application documents)
Communication (English) Skills (verified through application documents and interview)
Personal Motivation and Leadership Potential (verified through interview)
coverage: Travel allowance: roundtrip air ticket from home country to study post and local transportation
Stipend for food, lodging, and incidental expenses
application_method: Submit the required application documents to the applicant's respective Ministry of (Higher) Education, 1 September-31 October 2026
Ministry evaluation and endorsement of shortlisted candidates to SEARCA, 1-30 November 2026
Shortlisted applicants upload the same application requirements through the SEARCA iSCHO Portal, 1-31 December 2026
SEARCA documentary evaluation of shortlisted applicants, 1-15 January 2027
Interview of qualified applicants, 15 January-15 April 2027, in person or online
Release of application results from 31 May 2027, only for those with university acceptance letters
official.application_route: Apply first through your national Ministry of (Higher) Education; only shortlisted and endorsed applicants then upload the same documents to the SEARCA iSCHO portal.
official.citizenship_residency: Open to nationals of SEAMEO member countries who are regular employees of academic or research institutions or government agencies
official.international_eligibility: Open to nationals of SEAMEO member countries: Brunei Darussalam, Cambodia, Indonesia, Lao PDR, Malaysia, Myanmar, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Timor-Leste and Vietnam; study posts are in Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia and the Philippines
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Areas of specialization must be relevant to the promotion of agricultural and rural development (agriculture or related sciences), and applicants must be regular employees of academic or research institutions or government agencies
official.research_requirement: A brief description of the thesis/dissertation research is required; the research topic must be in line with the sustainable transformation of agricultural systems through innovation in Southeast Asia and contribute to SEARCA's stated outcomes
official.description: SEARCA states that the Full Master's and PhD Scholarship Program is fully funded by SEARCA to support highly qualified individuals from SEAMEO member countries, providing opportunities to pursue advanced studies in priority fields aligned with SEARCA's thrusts, with the goal of fostering innovation and sustainable development in the region. All applications are evaluated by SEARCA and the respective Ministries of the applicants.
official.region: Southeast Asia (SEAMEO member countries); study posts in Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia and the Philippines
official.program_type: Full Master's and PhD Scholarship Program funded by SEARCA (intergovernmental research and training centre under SEAMEO)
official.english_requirement: Preferred to have IELTS results of 6.0 or TOEFL iBT result of 75, taken within two years before application; all required application documents must be submitted in English

not_confirmed: published value of the stipend, tuition, travel or thesis allowances
verification.notes: Entitlements, eligibility, required documents, AY 2027-2028 timeline and evaluation criteria were read directly from SEARCA's own scholarship pages; searca.org publishes no monetary value for any entitlement and none appears in the linked ministry list or info-session material, so all amount fields stay null.

applicant_utility.summary: SEARCA pays the whole cost of a master's or PhD in agriculture and related sciences at one of six Southeast Asian universities, but you cannot apply to SEARCA directly: your national Ministry of (Higher) Education must hold your file by 31 October 2026 and shortlist you before SEARCA ever opens it. Only endorsed candidates get iSCHO portal access in December 2026, and the final award depends on also holding a university acceptance letter by the 31 May 2027 results release. Because SEARCA publishes no allowance figures, ask ECL-GSID directly what the monthly stipend and tuition support are worth before you commit to leaving your job.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Mid-career faculty, researchers or government technical staff from a SEAMEO member country who already have employer backing for a multi-year leave and a research topic tied to farmers' income, food security, climate resilience or farmer institutions.
application_readiness_checklist: Get your certificate of employment and the dual recommendation form (academic adviser AND employer) signed well before October, since missing signatures stall files at the ministry desk
Request original or certified true copies of your BS (and MS for PhD) transcripts with the university seal and the registrar's or head's original signature
Frame your proposed thesis description around one of SEARCA's four outcomes and name the specific study post and degree you want
Apply to IPB, UGM, UB, Kasetsart, UPM or UPLB in parallel, because SEARCA warns that awards go only to applicants who secured admission
Book IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL iBT 75 now if you have no result from the last two years; it is 'preferred', but the interview tests English communication
Schedule a medical examination early enough to obtain a doctor's fitness certification before the ministry deadline
common_rejection_risks: Missing the ministry window: there is no direct SEARCA application, and a file sent to SEARCA itself never enters the process
Being endorsed by the ministry but failing to upload the identical documents to iSCHO within 1-31 December 2026
No admission letter from an eligible university by results release, since SEARCA grants awards only to applicants who secured admission
Being over 40 for a master's or over 45 for a PhD at the time of application
Not being a regular employee of an academic or research institution or government agency
A research topic that does not map onto any of the four contribution outcomes
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: SEARCA publishes no allowance values, so the cash gap cannot be quantified from official pages; the entitlements cover tuition and school fees, a roundtrip air ticket plus local transport, thesis/dissertation support, books and supplies, health insurance and a stipend for food, lodging and incidentals, but visa fees, dependants' costs and any shortfall between the stipend and local living costs are not listed.
document_audit: Transcripts must be original or certified true copies bearing the university seal and the registrar's or university head's original signature; a plain printout fails documentary evaluation
PhD applicants must file transcripts for both the BS and MS degrees; a single transcript is incomplete
All documents must be in English, so anything issued in another language needs translation before the ministry submission
The recommendation form must carry both the academic adviser's and the employer's signatures
A doctor's certification of physical and mental fitness is mandatory and has lead-time risk in countries where appointments are slow
Diplomas or certificates of completion are required for every degree completed, not just the most recent one
alerts: The 31 October 2026 date belongs to your ministry, not to SEARCA; ministries endorse only during 1-30 November 2026
Interviews run from 15 January to 15 April 2027 and may be in person or online, so keep that window reachable and free
Results are released only from 31 May 2027 and only for applicants holding university acceptance letters
Age is measured at the time of application: 40 for master's, 45 for PhD
Do not aim this application at National Taiwan University, Sejong University or Tokyo NODAI; those study posts are reserved for SEARCA's joint scholarship programmes
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: File the complete document set with your national Ministry of (Higher) Education by 31 October 2026, get endorsed in November, then upload the identical documents to the SEARCA iSCHO portal during 1-31 December 2026 and sit the interview in the first months of 2027.
